SELECT fish_date_season AS season, (fish_date_doy/10)::int*10 AS doy_bucket,
       SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS ang,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS rate,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'three_quarter'
  AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 190 AND 320
GROUP BY season, doy_bucket
ORDER BY season, doy_bucket

SELECT index_id, value, avail_season, avail_doy
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 2
ORDER BY index_id, avail_doy DESC
